## Scouts Honor (Pin Pony)

Scouts Honor is a speaking Crystal Empire earth-pony stallion in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (G4). He is the cheerful spectator who insists on seeing baby Flurry Heart’s Crystalling up close—and later cries with happiness when it succeeds. His light-yellow coat, orange mane and tail, mint-green eyes, and three safety-pin cutie marks make him identifiable. See the [Crystal Pony character listing](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Crystal_Ponies).

*Names and voice.* *Scouts Honor* is a fan/wiki name, not a name spoken in the episode. The production credits identify him as *Pin Pony*, voiced by *Ian Hanlin* ([season-six credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_six)); Gameloft also uses *Pin Pony* for its playable Crystal Empire resident ([game profile](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Pin_Pony)). No separate identity or disguise is established.

*Appearances.* He has several intelligible lines in *“The Crystalling – Part 2” (S6E2)*, including his defense of the ceremony and his delighted reaction to Flurry Heart ([episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/The_Crystalling_-_Part_2)). He also appears in *Baby Flurry Heart’s Heartfelt Scrapbook*, episode 9, “The Crystalling” ([short-series episode listing](https://mlp-france.com/extras/bonus.php)).

## Important moments

All three scenes are in [the official full episode, “The Crystalling – Part 2” (S6E2)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SCbeNMoY7xc). *Exact scene timestamps unavailable*; none are guessed.

- *Defending a sacred tradition:* He insists on a close view of the Crystalling, showing how deeply the ritual matters to Crystal Empire citizens.
- *Still hoping during the crisis:* As an unnatural blizzard approaches, he calls the ceremony moving, unaware that the shattered Crystal Heart threatens the city.
- *Moved to tears at Flurry Heart’s presentation:* He rejoices as the revived ceremony unites the crowd’s love and helps restore the Crystal Heart.
